learning_outcomes.text: Apply decision making techniques to select a solution to a problem
Apply a fundamental knowledge of intellectual property law to protect a solution
Model product cost, sales and profit
Explain fundamental marketing and sales strategies and contract law

syllabus_topics: Selecting solutions from a range of options
Developing a specification to meet a customer need
Product/process analysis visualisation tools (IDEF, Value Stream Mapping)
Project planning methods; introduction to current standards (reference to standards such as PRINCE2)
Fundamental principles of intellectual property law
Marketing and sales strategies and fundamentals of contract law
Modelling product cost, sales, and profit
Economic modelling, sensitivities, forecasting cash flow (NPV) and investment appraisal
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
